text:
Neither dataset shows forest on this property in 2020.

- **JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (V4)**, the 2020 forest reference map, reports 0 ha of forest in 2020 (0% of the 2,843.1 ha asset).
- **Hansen Global Forest Change** shows 23 ha of tree cover in 2000. It also records tree-cover loss in 2008, 2015, 2017 and 2020 (0.8, 25.5, 4.8 and 67.7 ha). So there was tree cover earlier, but Hansen does not show forest standing in 2020, and the JRC map doesn't either.

The tool does not explain why the JRC map shows no forest, and the loss totals exceed the 2000 tree-cover area, so the two datasets don't fully reconcile.

The assessment itself covers only loss after 2020-12-31. It found no loss events of 0.5 ha or more in 2021–2025, and only 0.4 ha of sub-threshold loss in 2021. It makes no compliance finding.
